author: reek
body: Probe: the authority to rewrite firmware cannot be bought with the mechanism that implements it.

author: reek
body: This is the probe the whole capability exists for. Flash operations are memory-mapped register writes underneath, so a driver already holding [Device.Mmio] has every mechanism it needs -- and must still be refused, because it does not hold [Flash]. stage declares only Device.Mmio and performs Flash: CDX2031.

author: reek
body: If this probe ever passes, the effect was spelled as a member of the Device family and the manifest can no longer tell a program that blinks an LED from one that can overwrite its own boot image.

author: reek
body: The linear discipline is satisfied on purpose -- the bank is opened, written and sealed exactly once -- so the only thing left to reject is the undeclared authority.
